title: Isabelle Drummond and Maurício Destri to Star as Couple in Netflix Series
seoTitle: Isabelle Drummond & Maurício Destri in Netflix Series
subtitle: The actors will star in the adaptation of Camila Antunes' book “Deixa nevar,” produced by Glaz.
excerpt: Isabelle Drummond and Maurício Destri have been confirmed as the romantic leads in a new Netflix series.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The announcement that Isabelle Drummond and Maurício Destri will play a couple in a new Netflix series, based on the book “Deixa nevar,” excited the public and put the actress's name among the trending topics. The production promises to bring a story of romance and overcoming obstacles, uniting the actors in a project that is already generating high expectations.

Isabelle Drummond and Maurício Destri on Netflix

Isabelle Drummond and Maurício Destri have been confirmed as romantic leads in the Netflix series. The production is an adaptation of the book “Deixa nevar,” written by Camila Antunes. The series is written by Thereza Falcão and directed by Thiago Teitelroit, with Glaz in charge of production.

The story of “Deixa nevar”

The plot of the series “Deixa nevar” follows a jewelry designer who falls in love with a millionaire. The main characters are Vânia, the designer, and Marco, heir to one of the wealthiest families in Brazil. The story begins when Marco shows up at Vânia's jewelry store to return the most exclusive piece she has ever produced: an engagement ring. From this meeting, the two grow closer and find comfort for their personal struggles.

The actors' recent work

Isabelle Drummond recently played Naiane Sampaio, a villain in the telenovela “Coração Acelerado,” marking her return to telenovelas after a seven-year hiatus. Meanwhile, Maurício Destri, although away from telenovelas since 2018, when he starred in “Orgulho e Paixão,” has participated in other projects. He was in “Rensga Hits!” (2022-2025) and the Globoplay micro-drama “Herdeira por Direito, Milionária por Vingança,” in addition to the Netflix series “Luz” (2024).

Faith and spirituality in stories and life

The author of the book “Deixa nevar,” Camila Antunes, is a member of the Baptist Church and known for writing stories that address themes of faith and love. In line with this theme, Isabelle Drummond revealed in an interview her desire to become a mother and her spirituality, stating: “I am a practicing Christian.”

Maurício Destri's past

The casting of Maurício Destri for the role also drew attention due to his personal history. The actor had a brief relationship with Bruna Marquezine in 2015, while both were filming the telenovela “I Love Paraisópolis.” In an interview, Destri recalled the relationship, stating: “We still cheer for each other.” Currently, Maurício Destri is married to Sabrina Samel and has a son.

With information from O GLOBO, NaTelinha.
